in_sanskrit.name: प्राग्या
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has acquired knowledge, the wise, the intelligent.

in_marathi.name: Pragya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pragya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Pragya is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘prajna’ which means ‘wisdom’. It is a name given to a girl who is believed to possess deep understanding and knowledge.
